ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~24 day(s) ago @ 1041.65) and overbought (daily RSI 72). A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 13 · daily cycle day 40).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Daily momentum ~0 bars from turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (overbought (daily RSI 72)). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（已超买（日线 RSI 72））。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 40 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: inside the typical low-timing window — a dip is more likely from here, though the trend can keep running
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 40 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 处于典型的低点时间窗口内——从此处回调概率更高，但趋势仍可能延续
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 13 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 13 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 24 天前形成 @ 1041.65）且已超买（日线 RSI 72）。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 13 周 · 日线周期第 40 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A HIGH signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-25), switching from BOTTOMING. Signal strength: mild (score -20/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近高点信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-25），自筑底中切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 -20/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid exit setting up (-38)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健离场构筑中（-38）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

caveats: Risk cone (drawdown/vol) is the validated read; DIRECTION is display-only (measured coin-flip).
Cone widens with horizon; downside tail is the forecastable left side.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (1220) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（1220）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+1.1 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+1.1 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

alignment.line_zh: 周线周线上行 · 3日· · 日线临近上穿

entry_signal.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry_signal.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry_signal.action: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (overbought (daily RSI 72)). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry_signal.action_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（已超买（日线 RSI 72））。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

timing.next_trigger: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (overbought (daily RSI 72)). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate headwind.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率逆风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.07 ± 0.24 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLV) reads long-duration (+0.17). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.07 ± 0.24——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLV）为长久期（+0.17）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

caveat.en: Public-record alt-data convergence — the unusual-activity layer. Graded vs SPY in the Signal Intelligence ledger; weight by that track record, not a standalone trade signal.
caveat.zh: 公开记录替代数据汇聚——异常活动层。在信号情报战绩中对标普评分；据该战绩权衡，而非独立交易信号。

detail.en: Mid-range composite and accumulation — no contrarian extension or washout edge here.
detail.zh: 综合分与吸筹均处中位 — 无逆向高位或超卖的边际。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。

decision.headline: Hold off — timing against you
decision.gloss: Timing is against you right now — stand aside.
decision.gloss_zh: 当前时机不利——暂时观望。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (overbought (daily RSI 72)). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
timing.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（已超买（日线 RSI 72））。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Health Care (Equal-Weight)) is crowded / extended — cap size, don't add aggressively.
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（医疗保健（等权））拥挤／过度拉伸 — 控制仓位，勿激进加仓。

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 上行 · 较200日均线 +24% · 强趋势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -6% · 极端 -18% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
